task.question: What was the magnitude of the earthquake that hit Guangxi on May 18, 2026?
task.evidence: 18 May – A magnitude 5.2 earthquake hits Guangxi, killing two people and injuring four in Liuzhou.

answer:
Perfect! I found the information. According to the Wikipedia article on the 2026 Liuzhou earthquakes, on May 18, 2026, two doublet earthquakes struck Liuzhou in Guangxi, China.

FINAL: The earthquakes that hit Guangxi (Liuzhou) on May 18, 2026 had magnitudes of 5.0 and 5.1 (or 5.2 according to the China Earthquake Administration).
